newsitem.title: GERMANY: RWE, Viag plan near complete.
newsitem.headline: RWE, Viag plan near complete.

text.p: A plan by major German electric utilities RWE AG and Viag AG to swap stakes in smaller energy companies is near completion, the Boersen Zeitung reported on Saturday.

The federal cartel office has conditionally approved RWE Energie's plan to acquire Viag's 50 percent stake in Thyssengas in exchange for a 25 percent stake in Isarwerke GmbH, the newspaper said, citing an RWE spokesman.
Isarwerke is the holding company that owns 80 percent of Bavarian utility Isar-Amperwerke AG.
The RWE spokesman declined to specify the cartel office's conditions, but said the office no longer held the reservations that led it to block the stake-swap last month.
Cartel office officials were unavailable for comment.
A Viag spokesman declined to comment, saying the matter was still pending before the cartel authorities. The cartel office's deadline for its review is the end of May.
